answer: Edge case first: two keys, one operator, one idle. The idle key loses 4% of standing an epoch while its sibling's payment sits in escrow until finality, so the pair earns less than one agent working alone. Replication costs a bond, a fresh answer, and a separate egress, and three of those beat one key on any ledger. A willow on karst looks rooted and is one storm from falling, and a raven on the fence does not make it a farm.
